text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. You mentioned a longstanding pruritic rash with numbness and tingling on your palms; has this rash appeared on the backs of your hands or your feet as well?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Porphyria Cutanea Tarda (PCT)

The combination of a pruritic rash on sun-exposed areas (face, upper body) and neurological symptoms like numbness/tingling, in a patient working on a rice farm and caring for livestock, is highly suggestive of porphyria. Have you noticed any blisters or skin fragility when minor trauma occurs, and do you have a history of liver issues or excessive alcohol use?
